invariants.description: complete party preview, sorted organizations and users precede slices; drift restarts without late locks
prepare response before commit; distinguish failed, committed and ambiguous outcomes; never retry unknown commit
rebuild both benchmark sides for every changed order slice
amendment fields distinguish omitted, clearable and required-if-present values before locks
publication replay binds the recorded owner and accountable actor and survives admission change
newly execution-qualified order gets a new slice-locked acceptance ordinal
derive public events from committed before/after evidence, captured subscriptions and full public scope; deduplicate restart replay
suggestion candidates use the shared public relation and private-field projection
recorded-party cleanup remains available after rejection or detachment; confirm requires fresh admission
commission updates serialize and audit locked before and after values
commission administration reads only legacy commission rows; trade fee snapshots remain separate
manual and automatic confirmation share one exactly-once referral activation effect

schema_change_set.completion_gate: PHASE8_COMPLETENESS=1 and PHASE8_SCHEMA_BASE=<Task 5a integrated predecessor full SHA>; Task 14 after Task 5a; revisions added by other phases after the recorded base do not belong to this change set and do not fail it; PostgreSQL definition and ACL proof remain Task 5a gates
schema_change_set.parent_policy: single integrated Alembic head recorded immediately before Task 5a, not the Task 1 baseline head

columns.watchlist_events.producer: varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-python'; allowed values legacy-python, rust-market-v1
columns.watchlist_events.derived_event_key: varchar(255) NULL; nonempty on trusted rows
columns.market_event_outbox.producer_evidence: jsonb NULL DEFAULT NULL; internal envelope only

constraints.ck_watchlist_events_producer_identity: (producer = 'legacy-python' AND source_event_id IS NULL AND source_stream_seq IS NULL AND scope_attested_at IS NULL AND derived_event_key IS NULL) OR (producer = 'rust-market-v1' AND source_event_id IS NOT NULL AND source_stream_seq IS NOT NULL AND scope_attested_at IS NOT NULL AND derived_event_key IS NOT NULL AND char_length(derived_event_key) > 0)

indexes.uq_watchlist_events_producer_source_targ: UNIQUE (producer, source_event_id, watchlist_target_id, derived_event_key) WHERE source_event_id IS NOT NULL

denied: direct app EXECUTE on migrator helpers
acl.watchlist_targets: retain economic writer display UPDATE; consumer SELECT only
acl.watchlist_events: retain insertion and target cascade; no new DELETE
